record: Kent Historic Environment Record TQ 76 NE 1286
facts: Square brick and concrete tower begun in 1885. Construction stopped in 1888, and it was demolished in 1961. Grid TQ 7765 6701 pins the demolished monument.

record: The Strand Magazine 26 (152), August 1903, printed pp. 233–235
facts: The eyewitness article documents four essentially identical elevations, four corner towers, repeated device panels, a circular interior and galleries of bare steel, with twelve girders supporting a dome of which the framework alone existed.
Construction ended in 1888. The tower was sold in 1905 and subsequently reduced in height. This source provides only chronology.

record: Postmarked Shurey postcard of the full tower; transcribed early auction property description
facts: Supports the external dimensions as a large square and corroborates unfinished open walls and incomplete roof structure.
